prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 Instagram post designed like a premium online NEWS ARTICLE card (editorial journalism layout, credible and sober), with NO real newspaper name or logo.

Layout from top to bottom:
1. Thin top bar: small category chip in red "DESTAQUE" next to small grey text "LAJEADO/RS · 25/11". On the right of the bar, the small masthead text "ALÉM DO AGORA" in elegant caps.
2. Big serif headline (like a newspaper), dark navy on white paper background, 3 lines:
"Lajeado recebe imersão presencial de Inteligência Artificial para empresários"
3. One-line sans-serif standfirst in grey: "Encontro com Lucas Jesus acontece em 25/11, no Tri Hotel."
4. Large editorial photo (full width, about 55% of the height): a WIDE event photograph taken from the back of a dark auditorium. A speaker (a generic person, small in the frame, seen as a backlit silhouette so the face is not recognizable) stands in the center of a large stage, one arm raised toward a huge LED screen showing a clean blue AI business dashboard (no readable words). Cyan and blue spotlight beams cutting through haze, rows of seats and the backs of the audience's heads as dark out-of-focus silhouettes in the foreground (no faces). NO microphone. Real event photojournalism, 35mm lens, cinematic depth.
5. Overlapping the bottom-left corner of the photo, a white quote card with a big blue quotation mark: "A I.A. já mudou o trabalho. A pergunta agora é: o seu negócio já mudou?" and below it in small bold: "Lucas Jesus".
6. Leave the bottom 11% of the image as a clean dark navy band with nothing on it.

Colors: white/off-white paper, dark navy #0B1220 text, accents in electric blue #2F6BFF and cyan #22D3EE, the small red chip only.
Write every text exactly as given, Brazilian Portuguese with all accents, perfectly spelled, no other words, no fake bylines, no dates other than 25/11, no logos, no watermark.
